**Log Entry 52:**  
Just received new directives from Overseer Kuda for those of us left over on Sebb's team. Trading one taskmaster for another. We came on this expedition because we believed in Vloxx's vision, and now that the principal biomancer has up and died, it's only a matter of time before we end up as redundancies for the overseer to exploit.
I'd raise my concerns with the director himself, but I doubt he has time to address the worries of a small krewe supervisor about leadership changes.
Webbi's considering my idea to jump ship, surrendering to the alliance expedition, but she's hesitant. She has it in her head that this post is precious to me. And, yeah, it was a big deal, but it's still not worth either of our lives.

**Log Entry 55:**  
A fresh development! One of the alliance expeditioners wants a meeting for an information exchange. I'm coordinating the meet-up via some freebooter middleman (charr?) and it's sounding more legit. This could be how we get ourselves out and maybe even bargain for something that won't land us in some alliance jail, or whatever passes for one out here.  

**Log Entry 56:**  
Webbi's been on edge all morning, pacing the confines of our lab. Our rendezvous with the contact is today. If we play our cards right, we'll be out from under Kuda's thumb by the time the sun sets on the weald.

strings.en:
Valiant,

I hope this letter finds you in a summer breeze, carrying you toward warmer days with a path brightly lit. I am Firstborn Dagonet. Perhaps you remember me?

I've been aiding the Pale Mother in leading our people. She heals still. The process has been drawn out, but I'm glad to report that color returns to her cheeks. She is quite weak and tired yet, but frequent visits from the newborns raise her spirits. Her focus is always pointed toward the future of her children.

This is why I am writing to you today—that optimistic but often naïve promise of tomorrow. Despite the cold days that we've faced over this decade, something has happened. Something that feels quite different—and while it's a curious motion, I hope it will be good for our world. Leaders have started speaking on even ground about our shared ailments and woes, our strengths, and even our needs. I personally attribute this sudden action to the demons and their rampage on our lands.

The Tyrian Alliance will be holding its first summit shortly. Let us meet and discuss a plan.

—Dagonet

...And please, don't be so quick to dismiss the proposed alliance with the Speakers, my love. What you face is a different beast, and I want you home, safe. Swallow your pride and return to me. And if not for me, then for our child. Yes, our pleas to Soo-Won have been answered. What I would give to see your face as you read this. I would smother it in kisses...

Please please return, my love. My heart screams it a thousand times.

Know this. You are not fighting an otherworldly beast anymore. You are fighting for our family. For the future we dreamt of, ever since we were first wed.

Touch your hand to your chest and know I am with you.

—Sanda xxx
